description.zh: 页面号码，分页查询时指定当前页码。
description.en: The page number. Specifies the current page number for paging queries.

description.zh: 页面大小，分页查询时指定每页的记录数量。
description.en: The page size. Specifies the number of records per page for paging queries.

description.zh:
WAF规则运行阶段。
- http_whitelist：白名单规则
- http_custom：自定义规则
- http_managed：托管规则
- http_anti_scan：扫描防护规则
- http_ratelimit：频次控制规则
- ip_access_rule：IP访问规则
- http_bot：高级模式Bots
- http_security_level_rule：安全规则
description.en:
The WAF rule execution phase. Valid values:
- http_whitelist: whitelist rules
- http_custom: custom rules
- http_managed: managed rules
- http_anti_scan: scan protection rules
- http_ratelimit: frequency control rules
- ip_access_rule: IP access rules
- http_bot: advanced mode bots
- http_security_level_rule: security rules

description.zh: 查询参数，以JSON格式传递，包含各种筛选条件。
description.en: The query parameters, passed in JSON format, including various filter conditions.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

description.zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0。
description.en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-waf-rulesets --site-id 1 --site-version 0 --phase http_bot --query-args http_bot --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa ListWafRulesets --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1 --Phase http_bot --QueryArgs http_bot --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --SiteVersion 0
